autotile.index: TL*1 + TR*2 + BL*4 + BR*8; bit = corner is dirt, 0 = grass
autotile.name: grass_dirt_<index:02d>_v<variant>
autotile.variant_rule: any variant fits any neighbour; pick per cell, e.g. hash(x, y) % variants

autotile.index: TL*1 + TR*2 + BL*4 + BR*8; bit = corner is water, 0 = grass
autotile.name: grass_water_<index:02d>_v<variant>
autotile.variant_rule: any variant fits any neighbour; pick per cell, e.g. hash(x, y) % variants

autotile.index: N*1 + E*2 + S*4 + W*8; bit = path continues that way
autotile.name: path_<index:02d>_v<variant>
autotile.note: use a connector where a narrow path meets the wide road; open the north bit under a door

layout: BL  B  B_end_L  (doorway)  B_end_R  B  BR

notes.caps: cap_<material>_<kind>; kinds: TL, T, TR, L, R, BL, B, BR, B_end_L, B_end_R, L_end_top, L_end_bottom, R_end_top, R_end_bottom, inner_T_L, inner_T_R, inner_B_L, inner_B_R
notes.inner_corners: inner_A_B = the A cap and the B cap in one tile (e.g. inner_T_R where a right-hand wall turns into a top wall)
notes.side_doorways: L_end_bottom above the gap, L_end_top below it (same for R)
notes.cap_transitions: cap_<T|B|L|R>_<from>_to_<to>: T/B change left->right, L/R change top->bottom

autotile.index: TL*1 + TR*2 + BL*4 + BR*8; bit = corner is the second material
autotile.name: floor_<a>_<b>_<index:02d>
autotile.note: tile 0 = all first material, 15 = all second; seams run along tile midlines

link.note: stairs_up covers a wall-face cell and the floor cell below it; walking into its top half loads the linked room and places the player on the paired stairs

actions.note: sit: hips sit 8px above the frame bottom of a stool (draw the sitter 8px higher than the stool); sit_down is seen over the far side of a table (legs hidden), sit_up from behind. eat ~3 fps, carry walk 8 fps, work ~4 fps (stand one tile below the station)

animated.note: fire, candle and cask loops ~6 fps; water ~3 fps (ping-pong highlights, stays seamless)

animals.note: walk ~6 fps; peck/graze/root ~2 fps; the cat sleep frame is a pose, not a loop

ambient.note: overlays: bees over a beehive (~8 fps), jumping trout over a fishing spot (~4 fps, then pause)

wagons.note: 64x32 east/west views; the horse is hitched in the rolling frames (~6 fps). wagon_parked_* has no horse. North/south views are in wagons_ns.

wagons_ns.note: 32x64 north/south views. down = heading south (horse at the bottom, nearest the viewer); up = heading north (horse at the top).

characters.note: right = mirrored left (both included); suggested walk speed 8 fps

note: Pictures only. What things are (items, recipes, sources, shops, folk) lives in gamedata.json.

ui_frames.note: 'slice' = 9-slice border in px: one number for all sides or [left, top, right, bottom]; repeat edges/centre rather than stretching

ui_emotes.note: emote_request is empty: draw a food sprite inside it

ui_font_digits.note: 5x7 glyphs with 1px outline; draw 6px apart so outlines overlap

ui_font_letters.note: capitals and punctuation, same style as ui_font_digits; use both sheets together; space = 4px

ui_font_lower.note: lowercase a-z; draw at the same y as capitals and digits (shared baseline), the extra bottom row is for descenders

ui_frames2.note: more 9-slice pieces (tabs, text fields, dropdown, tooltip, toast, ribbon banner, slider/scroll tracks, card, divider); 'slice' as in ui_frames

ui_controls.note: slider: draw slider_track (9-slice), slider_fill up to the value, then slider_knob; scroll: scroll_track + scroll_thumb + scroll_up/down

ui_icons2.note: system icons; same grid and style as ui_icons

ui_keys.animation: alternate <name> and <name>_pressed at ~3 fps to make a prompt pulse

ui_loading.note: spinner ~10 fps; timer_ring_0..8 = empty..full (pick by progress)

ui_font_ink.note: all characters in dark brown ink with no outline, for light panels (parchment, cards, text fields); same baseline and spacing as the outlined fonts

ui_xbox.animation: alternate <name> and <name>_pressed at ~3 fps to make a prompt pulse
